abstract:
BACKGROUND: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC) with gemcitabine plus S-1 (GS) is the standard treatment for resectable pancreatic cancer (PC) in Japan. More intensive regimens, such as gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel (GnP), are widely used globally. However, whether the survival benefit observed in randomized trials can be reproduced in clinical practice remains unclear. This study aimed to compare oncological outcomes among patients treated with upfront surgery (UF), NAC-GnP, or NAC-GS to elucidate the potential optimal treatment strategy for anatomically resectable pancreatic head cancer.
METHODS: This retrospective single-center cohort study included patients with anatomically resectable pancreatic head cancer who underwent pancreaticoduodenectomy (PD) at a single institution between 2012 and 2022. The patients were classified according to their preoperative treatment strategy: UF, NAC-GnP, or NAC-GS. Perioperative outcomes, pathological findings, recurrence-free survival (RFS), and overall survival (OS) were compared between groups.
RESULTS: Of the 206 patients who underwent PD, 196 were included in the three-group comparison (UF: 112; NAC-GnP: 45; NAC-GS: 39). The treatment era differed significantly among the groups. Perioperative outcomes, lymph node metastasis rates, R0 resection rates, postoperative adjuvant chemotherapy administration, recurrence patterns, OS, and RFS did not significantly differ among the groups. In the multivariable Cox regression analysis that used pretreatment variables, an initial carbohydrate antigen 19-9 (CA19-9) level ≥37 U/mL was independently associated with worse OS, whereas receipt of NAC was not significantly associated with OS.
CONCLUSIONS: A clear survival advantage of NAC-GS or NAC-GnP over UF was not demonstrated in patients with anatomically resectable pancreatic head cancer who underwent PD. These findings highlight the need for improved strategies to identify patients most likely to benefit from neoadjuvant treatment.
key_points_ko: 총 196명의 췌장두부암 환자를 선행 수술(112명), NAC-GnP(45명), NAC-GS(39명) 그룹으로 나누어 치료 결과를 비교했습니다.
수술 전 선행 항암요법(NAC) 치료군과 선행 수술군 간에 전체 생존기간(OS) 및 무재발 생존기간(RFS), 완전 절제율(R0)의 유의미한 차이가 관찰되지 않았습니다.
치료 시작 전 당사슬항원 19-9(CA19-9) 수치가 37 U/mL 이상인 경우가 전체 생존기간 악화의 독립적인 위험 요인으로 확인되었습니다.
summary_ko: 본 연구는 해부학적으로 수술 가능한 췌장두부암 환자를 대상으로 수술 전 선행 항암요법(NAC)의 효과를 평가한 후향적 코호트 연구입니다. 췌두십이지장절제술(PD)을 받은 196명의 환자를 선행 수술(UF 112명), gemcitabine(젬시타빈)+nab-paclitaxel(납-파클리탁셀) 선행치료(NAC-GnP 45명), gemcitabine+S-1 선행치료(NAC-GS 39명) 그룹으로 나누어 비교했습니다. 연구 결과 수술 전 선행 항암요법 시행 여부에 따른 전체 생존기간(OS) 및 무재발 생존기간(RFS)의 유의미한 차이는 관찰되지 않았습니다.
title: Reassessing standard neoadjuvant gemcitabine plus S-1 for resectable pancreatic head cancer: a retrospective cohort study
title_ko: 수술 가능한 췌장두부암에서 표준 수술 전 선행 항암요법(젬시타빈+S-1)의 효과 재평가: 단일 기관 후향적 코호트 연구
